slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any requirement that each student must work a minimum number of days per week (e.g., at least 2 days), or is the only weekly constraint the total hours floor (8 or 7 hours depending on level)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about minimum days per week, which is related to weekly day/shift limits, but did not ask about a maximum number of shifts or working days per student per week.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether there is a daily limit on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan: (a) minimize the total weekly wage cost (sum of wage × hours over all students); (b) minimize total hours worked; or (c) something else, such as maximizing fairness or minimizing the number of students used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and included minimizing total weekly wage cost as an option.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no maximum limit on the number of shifts or working days per student per week.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked only about a minimum-days requirement and did not confirm whether a maximum weekly shift/day limit exists, yet the READY_TO_MODEL summary states there is no minimum-days constraint and omits any maximum shift/day limit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no daily limit on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct students per day, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists no such constraint and effectively assumes it is absent.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while P1 hidden slots H1 and H2 remained unresolved; H1 was only partially touched and H2 was not asked about.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and several operational details, but stopped before resolving the P1 weekly shift/day limit and daily distinct-student limit, leaving those as silent assumptions in the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
